projectDescription: A community n8n node that connects your workflows to the Agentova API, enabling you to manage users and companies directly inside n8n automations.
keyFeatures: Drag-and-drop n8n node for Agentova API integration
User resource: Get Many, Get by ID, Create
Company resource: Get Many with automatic pagination
Bearer token authentication via API key
Usable as an AI tool node inside n8n agent workflows
Automatic offset-based pagination for large result sets
publicApiSurface: GET /users/:id — retrieve a single user by ID
